# TAO (JUNO-TAO), arXiv:2610.23331v1, Fig. 26: energy leakage + non-linearity matrix M_leak+NL(E_true, E_vis)
# for the fiducial volume R <= 800 mm. E_true = T_e+ + 1.022 MeV; E_vis = visible energy in the GdLS with the
# non-linearity applied, BEFORE energy-resolution smearing (Eq. 17-18 of the paper).
#
# Source: the figure is a raster image embedded in the PDF (855 x 971 px, viridis colour map, log colour scale
# from 1 to ~3700 events). Each colour was mapped back to a value through the embedded colour bar (254 colours,
# each covering ~0.011 decades, i.e. +-1.3% in value); values below 30 are rounded to integers, which they match
# to within 2-3% (1.02, 1.99, 3.03, ...), confirming the plot shows raw Monte Carlo counts.
# Axis calibration from the tick marks; pixel size 0.012245 MeV on both axes.
#
# IMPORTANT: the paper fills the matrix in 5-keV x 5-keV bins, and the rendered image has ~2.45 bins per pixel.
# Each pixel therefore shows (a sample of) the count in ONE 5-keV bin, not the sum over the pixel. Use the
# normalised column 'p_density' for the response; it is independent of this sampling.
#
# Columns:
#  E_true    pixel-centre true energy (MeV); covered range 1.022-11.480 MeV (no events plotted above)
#  E_vis     pixel-centre visible energy (MeV)
#  counts    Monte Carlo events in the 5-keV x 5-keV bin at this position, as plotted
#  p_density P(E_vis | E_true) as a density per MeV: counts / (sum of counts in this E_true column x 0.012245 MeV).
#            Integrating p_density over E_vis gives 1 for every column.
# Only non-empty pixels are listed (white = no events). High-E_true columns have few events and are noisy.
#
